data.one_liner: Animated outline icons with forward/reverse transitions and configurable appearance
data.what_it_does: Provides 14 built‑in outline icons that animate between active and inactive states. The widget handles animation timing, curve, stroke width, and theme inheritance, and supports semantic labels and reduced motion.
use_when: You need lightweight animated icons without external dependencies
You want to customize icon size, color, stroke width, and animation curve
You prefer a single widget that manages its own animation controller
avoid_when: You require a large icon set or custom shapes not in the 14 provided
You need to animate icons with complex custom paths or external SVGs
You are building a highly performance‑critical UI where every animation frame matters
strengths: Configurable animation duration, curve, and stroke width
Inherits IconTheme and supports semantic labels
weaknesses: No support for custom icon shapes
Animation controller is internal, not exposed for advanced control
data.setup_notes: Add dependency in pubspec and import package; no permissions or build_runner needed

alternatives.name: lottie
alternatives.why_pick_it: Use for complex vector animations and full control over frames

alternatives.name: flutter_animate
alternatives.why_pick_it: Provides a broader set of animation helpers for widgets
